Socket fixture POST install sent default200 and an id-only receipt. Canonical tool install returns202 and a typed pending operation; fixture now supplies full required fields. The subsequent GET socket still blocks until cancellation and committed effect count remains1.

productionProofs: docs/openapi.yaml: monitoring read/preview200; lifecycle/retry202; tools install202 and ToolOperation schema
addedNegative: A mocked synchronous200 for durable install is rejected; category validation remains unchanged.
limits: Focused correction proof does not replace a clean frozen full-suite/build/browser rerun.
